what_this_site_does_because_of_it: No automated league capture is configured or scheduled anywhere in this repository.
The captures on this site were read page by page during a review session and are published as a dated snapshot with links, not as a maintained feed.
No market price, odds, line or closing number is stored or published, because none was obtained from a source with a licence to redistribute it.
Raw row-level capture data remains in the published repository tree, which is a violation risk under the public/private split requirement. It is flagged (L-F-04) rather than presented as compliant.
legal_basis.not_stated: This is not legal advice. Sections 15-18 of the terms were not read in this session and are not characterised.

policy_options.name: Derived analysis only, no raw retention
policy_options.effect: The public site publishes derived tables, aggregates and links. Raw capture rows are not retained after derivation.
policy_options.unblocks: The safest publication posture; lets the analysis layer stay live.
policy_options.blocks: Nothing can be replayed or re-verified later, so the cross-capture audit that found a transcription error in an earlier session would no longer be possible.

policy_options.name: Raw retained in a private store
policy_options.effect: Captures move outside the published tree into a private store with freshness and schema-change alerts; the public site keeps only derived output and links.
policy_options.unblocks: Snapshots, diffs, replays, and the point-in-time ledger, without publishing raw league content.
policy_options.blocks: Nothing; this is the target posture.

current_policy: POL-A (default until the owner sets the field). Chosen by default, not by the owner - it is the strictest option, so the default cannot publish anything the owner would have withheld.
owner_decision_field: Set 'current_policy' to POL-A, POL-B or POL-C and name the approver. Until then, no backtest, ROI, closing-line value or originated residual may be published anywhere on this site.

snapshot_store_spec.purpose: Record the opening and closing numbers for every market we originate, so closing-line value and backtests are computable.
snapshot_store_spec.immutability: Append-only. A correction is a new row with a later observed_at_utc, never an edit of an existing row.
snapshot_store_spec.opening_definition: The first price observed for that market at that book, after a named freeze offset. The offset must be set before the first capture, otherwise 'opening' is whatever time the job happened to run.
snapshot_store_spec.closing_definition: The last price observed before kickoff, with the kickoff time taken from the official schedule, not from the book.
snapshot_store_spec.why_the_definitions_are_frozen_first: If opening and closing are defined after seeing which definition produces better CLV, the metric is fitted to the noise it is supposed to measure.
snapshot_store_spec.status: Spec published. 0 rows, because no price source is licensed (Q-PRICE-01).

vig_free_decomposition_spec.purpose: Separate genuine pricing divergence from operator margin before any bet structure is considered.
steps: 1. Convert each book's prices to implied probabilities using that book's own price format; do not average prices, average probabilities.
2. Normalise the implied probabilities within a market so they sum to 1. The excess is the book's overround, i.e. the vig.
3. The vig-free consensus is the mean of the normalised probabilities across books, weighted by a rule set before the first capture (equal weighting is the default and the safest).
4. The originated fair line is produced by our own model, independently of the books.
5. Residual = originated fair probability minus vig-free consensus probability, per market.
6. Publish the residual, the vig removed, and the number of books behind the consensus, as three separate columns.
vig_free_decomposition_spec.what_is_not_done: No book count, no vig estimate and no consensus value is published, because no book price exists in this environment.
vig_free_decomposition_spec.failure_mode_guarded: Comparing an originated price to a single book's raw price measures the book's margin, not our skill. The decomposition exists so that mistake cannot be made silently.

residual_publication_schedule.requirement: Price a line ourselves and publish the residual against the market, on a schedule, from day one.
residual_publication_schedule.schedule_spec: One residual row per originated market per fixture, published before kickoff, and stored immutably. Two rows per market minimum: the forecast-time price and the closing price.
residual_publication_schedule.status: Schedule and schema published. 0 rows, blocked on Q-PRICE-01.
residual_publication_schedule.day_one_rule: The residual must be published for the first originated week, including the weeks where the residual is unfavourable. A residual series that starts after a good week is a selection artefact.

drift_alarm_spec.rule: Every parser is pinned to an expected row count range and a set of required fields. A missing field or an out-of-range count fails the build loudly; it does not publish a blank.

applied_to.pin: 28 clubs and 14 fixtures; every row must carry player, club, position, practice status and a report_url
one row per game_id; every FINAL row must carry both scores and a source_url; a game the official page does not mark FINAL must carry nulls and a note

drift_alarm_spec.not_applied_to: Every parser that does not exist yet. The rule is that each new capture ships with its pin, not that pins are added later.
